summary: A Depth subscription on an NFO future: after the dk snapshot a df sends every bid level as price 0 and quantity 0, then a df restores five bids.

notes: The desktop takes a 0 price in a df as the level gone and publishes the bid side empty; the web drops levels without a price and keeps the previous side when none is left (aliceblue_adapter.py:700-718). Which is right depends on what AliceBlue means by a 0 price in a df (a cleared level, or unchanged, as both codebases say AliceBlue sends 0 for unchanged prices in ticks): audit appendix item 10, a live capture decides.

deviations.reason: The web's AliceBlue data carries no symbol (aliceblue_adapter.py:1243-1305); the frame's top level names the instrument and mode, as the web's envelope does. Its presence in data follows each broker's web adapter (lead ruling 2026-11-09): closed by the per-broker dialect switch.

The web's AliceBlue data carries no exchange (aliceblue_adapter.py:1243-1305); the frame's top level names the instrument and mode, as the web's envelope does. Its presence in data follows each broker's web adapter (lead ruling 2026-11-09): closed by the per-broker dialect switch.

The web's AliceBlue data carries no mode (aliceblue_adapter.py:1243-1305); the frame's top level names the instrument and mode, as the web's envelope does. Its presence in data follows each broker's web adapter (lead ruling 2026-11-09): closed by the per-broker dialect switch.

The web's Depth timestamp is AliceBlue's feed time ft as it came, a string of epoch seconds; the frame timestamp is epoch milliseconds as a number (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends the receipt time.

The web's Depth has no ltt: it puts AliceBlue's feed time, as a string of epoch seconds, in timestamp instead (aliceblue_mapping.py:255, aliceblue_adapter.py:1295-1300). The desktop sends the trade time as ltt in ms and its receipt time as timestamp, as every frame does.

AliceBlue's depth packet carries volume and the web's Depth dict leaves it out, sending only ltp, timestamp and the book (aliceblue_adapter.py:1270-1300): market data the broker sent, lost (lead ruling 2026-11-09). The desktop's Depth frame keeps it, as docs/api/websocket-streaming/depth.md shows the quote beside the book.
